name: Shindou Mei
source:
She is honest, innocent, and curious. On the other hand, she is also quite jealous.

A “younger sister” who has lived with him. She still lives at home with the main character.

She has a tendency to exaggerate things. She is quite the fussy eater.

Lost her parents twice.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/akiba/charashokai/mei.htm]official site[/url]]
